label: late copy phase: last two output steps
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, never on original tokens or the <DEL> step, and never at recall_idx 0-1. Most activity falls on the last two copy steps (to_go 0: 57% of mass, to_go 1: 24%), and it never fires when 6 or more outputs remain. The strongest activations are on the final step of L=3 sequences when the input is an m (e.g. b m m <DEL> b [m]). Only about a quarter of the late copy steps actually fire, and which ones do depends weakly on token identity (higher for input m/0/3 and output e/j/t) and on L (rare at L=5, common at L=3). Token-list refinements did not raise F1, so precision stays low.
